user.title: Tailscale OAuth client
user.description: Enter OAuth client credentials with policy_file write scope. The default tailnet value - selects the OAuth client’s own tailnet. Existing ACL domains become switches automatically.

data.tailnet: Tailnet ID (use - for this OAuth client’s tailnet)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tailscale API or obtain an OAuth token. Check connectivity and try again.
error.policy_forbidden: Tailscale ACL API returned HTTP 403. Check the OAuth client’s tailnet and policy_file scope.
error.tailnet_not_found: Tailscale ACL API returned HTTP 404. Check the tailnet ID or use - for this OAuth client’s tailnet.
error.api_error: Tailscale ACL API returned an error. Check the Home Assistant log for the HTTP status.
error.invalid_policy: Tailscale returned a policy that this integration could not parse. Check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Manage app domains
init.description: Choose an existing app and add, remove, or rename a domain pair.

change.title: Edit {connector} domains
change.description: The parent domain and its wildcard are saved as a pair. Select an existing domain to remove or rename it.

error.invalid_domains: Check the domain and current app list.
error.cannot_connect: Could not save or refresh the policy.

abort.no_domains: This app has no domains yet.
